surgery_worry.next_step: Write down your surgery questions and ask your surgical team to talk through what to expect.

rehab_pain.reflection: Your knee discomfort after rehab sounds frustrating.
rehab_pain.next_step: Tell your physiotherapist which exercises caused discomfort and ask them to review your plan.

results_wait.reflection: Waiting for test results can feel unsettling.
results_wait.next_step: Ask the clinic when results are expected and who you can contact with questions while you wait.

medication_question.reflection: Having questions about medication instructions is understandable.
medication_question.next_step: Write down the unclear instructions and ask your pharmacist to explain them before making any changes.

needle_fear.reflection: Feeling nervous about needles is not something to be embarrassed about.
needle_fear.next_step: Tell the nurse about your needle worries before the blood draw and ask what support is available.

appointment_confusion.reflection: Unclear appointment directions can be stressful.
appointment_confusion.next_step: Call the clinic office to confirm the appointment location and ask for written directions.

rehab_motivation.reflection: Keeping up a rehab routine can feel discouraging.
rehab_motivation.next_step: Tell your therapist what makes the routine difficult and ask them to help set a manageable goal.

feeling_unheard.reflection: Feeling unheard during a rushed visit can be upsetting.
feeling_unheard.next_step: Write down your main concerns and ask the clinic for a follow-up conversation to discuss them.

sleep_before_visit.reflection: Worry about the hospital visit is making sleep difficult.
sleep_before_visit.next_step: Write down what is keeping you awake and ask the hospital team to explain the visit plan.

family_support.reflection: Asking family for help during recovery can feel difficult.
family_support.next_step: List the practical tasks you need help with and ask a relative to choose one they can support.

cost_worry.reflection: Uncertainty about clinic costs can be stressful.
cost_worry.next_step: Ask the billing office for an explanation of the charges and who can discuss available support.

transport.reflection: Transport difficulties can make an upcoming appointment stressful.
transport.next_step: Contact the clinic to explain the transport problem and ask whether they can suggest support options.

diagnosis_worry.reflection: A new diagnosis can leave you feeling overwhelmed.
diagnosis_worry.next_step: Write down your diagnosis questions and ask your care team to explain the next discussion in plain language.

work_conversation.reflection: Discussing recovery and appointments at work can feel worrying.
work_conversation.next_step: List the scheduling support you need and ask your manager for a private conversation about work arrangements.

accessible_instructions.reflection: Instructions that are hard to read can make things feel confusing.
accessible_instructions.next_step: Ask the clinic for instructions in an accessible format and request a conversation to check your understanding.

follow_up_plan.reflection: An unclear follow-up plan can leave you with unanswered questions.
follow_up_plan.next_step: Ask the clinic to confirm your contact person and explain how to send questions about the follow-up plan.
